command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

echo "== verify every pinned input by sha256 =="
{ printf '%s  %s\n' 9cbf9ddc5b88c33f3103b56defb66b966c89f47c0988757077c651bfa6d92f6c viral_20240605.tar
  printf '%s  %s\n' 0891c00cc2d503f58e0c600ce5ee64e9c64b939525c70d5486bc46cbc7cb073e NC_045512.2.fasta
  printf '%s  %s\n' a5d0c305e567432806a5e68a99baf61cd67ab37a21414a3b310790fcb83e01a5 NC_001802.1.fasta
  printf '%s  %s\n' f67fb089e5d313a56c7d8ddc51e1fd7beecc5544d3e355d74c821cd4ef7f0321 NC_003977.2.fasta
  printf '%s  %s\n' ebf7834e615c60f819b2fed442ecf1c2fcf5eb52362edcba28f8f0730e407101 NC_001526.4.fasta
} > pins.sha256
sha256sum -c pins.sha256

# Directory DB travels as one flat tar. Do NOT rm the staged tar: host /tmp is sticky 1777,
# stage-in runs as the instance user, and rm -f does not suppress EPERM.
mkdir -p db && tar -xf viral_20240605.tar -C db
test -s db/hash.k2d
# Bracken needs only this one 745 KB file, so hand it on instead of the 633 MiB DB.
cp db/database100mers.kmer_distrib .

echo "== a mixture with planted proportions: 1000 / 600 / 300 / 100 of 2000 reads =="
: > mix.fasta
: > planted.tsv
mk(){ # taxid accession nreads label
  awk -v f="$2.fasta" -v N="$3" -v tag="$2" 'BEGIN{
    while ((getline l < f) > 0) if (l !~ /^>/) s = s l
    L=length(s); RL=100; stride=int((L-RL)/N); if (stride<1) stride=1
    for(i=0;i<N;i++){ p = 1 + (i*stride) % (L-RL+1); printf ">%s_r%d\n%s\n", tag, i+1, substr(s,p,RL) }
  }' >> mix.fasta
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4" >> planted.tsv
}
mk 694009  NC_045512.2 1000 "SARS-related coronavirus"
mk 11676   NC_001802.1  600 "HIV-1"
mk 337041  NC_001526.4  300 "Alphapapillomavirus 9"
mk 10407   NC_003977.2  100 "Hepatitis B virus"
NREADS=$(awk '/^>/{n++} END{print n+0}' mix.fasta)
PLANTED=$(awk -F'\t' '{n+=$3} END{print n}' planted.tsv)
test "$NREADS" = "$PLANTED" || { echo "wrote $NREADS reads, planted $PLANTED"; exit 1; }
{ printf 'planted_reads\t%s total\n' "$NREADS"
  awk -F'\t' '{printf "planted_%s\t%s reads (%.0f%%)  taxid %s  %s\n", $2, $3, 100*$3/2000, $1, $4}' planted.tsv; } | tee fixture.txt

echo "== classify =="
kraken2 --db db --output mix.kraken --report mix.report mix.fasta 2> kraken2.log
cat kraken2.log
CLASS=$(awk '$1=="C"{n++} END{print n+0}' mix.kraken)
UNCL=$(awk '$1=="U"{n++} END{print n+0}' mix.kraken)
test $(( CLASS + UNCL )) = "$NREADS" || { echo "classified+unclassified != reads"; exit 1; }

echo "== where the reads actually landed, by rank =="
awk -F'\t' '{r[$4]+=$3} END{for(k in r) if(r[k]>0) printf "  rank %-4s direct-assigned %s\n", k, r[k]}' mix.report | sort
ATS=$(awk -F'\t' '$4=="S"{n+=$3} END{print n+0}'  mix.report)
ATS1=$(awk -F'\t' '$4=="S1"{n+=$3} END{print n+0}' mix.report)

echo "== the headline: the DOMINANT species has ZERO reads assigned AT species rank =="
read -r DOMRANK DOMCLADE DOMDIRECT < <(awk -F'\t' '$5==694009{print $4, $2, $3; exit}' mix.report)
printf 'taxid 694009  rank %s  clade_reads %s  direct_at_species %s\n' "$DOMRANK" "$DOMCLADE" "$DOMDIRECT"
test "$DOMCLADE"  = "1000" || { echo "clade reads for the dominant species is $DOMCLADE, planted 1000"; exit 1; }
test "$DOMDIRECT" = "0"    || { echo "NOTE: direct species assignment is now $DOMDIRECT, not 0"; exit 1; }
test "$ATS1" -gt "$ATS"    || { echo "expected more reads below species (S1=$ATS1) than at it (S=$ATS)"; exit 1; }

# no species may claim more reads than were planted for it
awk -F'\t' 'FNR==NR{p[$1]=$3; next} $5 in p && $2 > p[$5] {
  printf "taxid %s clade reads %s exceeds planted %s\n", $5, $2, p[$5]; bad=1 } END{exit bad?1:0}' planted.tsv mix.report

{
printf 'kraken2 on a planted mixture -- classification is not abundance\n'
printf 'reads\t%s   (assert == planted total)\n' "$NREADS"
printf 'classified\t%s   unclassified %s   (assert sum == %s, CONSERVATION)\n' "$CLASS" "$UNCL" "$NREADS"
printf 'assigned_at_species_S\t%s\n' "$ATS"
printf 'assigned_below_species_S1\t%s   (assert > S -- most reads resolve BELOW species rank)\n' "$ATS1"
printf 'dominant_clade_reads\t%s   (assert 1000 -- EXACT, every planted SARS read is in the clade)\n' "$DOMCLADE"
printf 'dominant_direct_at_species\t%s   (assert 0 -- the species holding 50%% of the sample gets ZERO\n' "$DOMDIRECT"
printf 'dominant_direct_at_species\t     reads at species rank, because they all resolve to a strain below it)\n'
printf 'note\tsumming the species-rank DIRECT column would report %s of %s reads and put the\n' "$ATS" "$NREADS"
printf 'note\tmost abundant organism at zero. That is what Bracken exists to fix.\n'
} | tee smoke-check-kraken2.txt
echo "KRAKEN2 CHECK PASSED"
